analysis.reasonEn: RSI is hovering in the 30-45 range with weak signs of exiting oversold. MACD histogram has turned negative from positive 5 days ago, indicating worsening momentum. ADX at 42.0 suggests a clear trend, but the DI indicator (-DI significantly larger than +DI) shows downward pressure dominance. Volume is subdued at 0.20 times the 5-day average. The current price of $274.59 is below the SMA200 ($276.81) by -0.80% and below the EMA50 ($283.78) by -3.24%, indicating downward pressure from medium-term moving averages. The 52-week position is 59.9%, a neutral range.
